extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, people seeking mental health resources, and press/media contacts seeking NIMH information
extracted.subtask_description: A contact-and-resources page for the National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH) listing crisis helplines, service referral resources, and channels for press, funding, website, and general inquiries. It explains what NIMH does not provide and where to direct different types of requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: No personalized medical advice or services
rubrics_metrics.description: NIMH is a biomedical research organization and does not provide personalized medical advice, treatment, counseling, referral services, social services, or legal consultation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not contact NIMH expecting individualized medical care or referrals; instead follow the listed crisis and referral resources (e.g., 911, 988, SAMHSA) for immediate or clinical needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crisis instructions / Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
rubrics_metrics.description: In life-threatening situations, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room. If you are suicidal or in emotional distress, consider using the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: call or text 988 or start a chat online to connect with a trained crisis counselor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Lifeline provides 24-hour, confidential support to anyone in suicidal crisis or emotional distress; use these resources rather than contacting NIMH for crisis intervention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Referrals for mental health and substance use treatment
rubrics_metrics.description: For referrals to substance use and mental health treatment programs, call the SAMHSA National Helpline at 1-800-662-HELP (4357) or visit FindTreatment.gov. MedlinePlus Directories offers a list of resources for locating a broader range of health practitioners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SAMHSA, FindTreatment.gov, or MedlinePlus for locating treatment providers; NIMH does not provide direct referral services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press resources / Requesting comment
rubrics_metrics.description: Request comment via the NIH press resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media and press inquiries should go through the NIH press resources channel (follow NIH process) rather than contacting NIMH staff directly via general inquiry addresses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research funding information and contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on NIMH funding opportunities, policies, and contacts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Researchers seeking funding guidance or policy information should consult the NIMH Research Funding resources and the listed contacts for program-specific questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Website technical issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Email the NIMH webmaster with any web-related questions or problems accessing our website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report site-access problems or technical bugs to the webmaster rather than other NIMH contact points.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other questions — general contact
rubrics_metrics.description: For other questions, email nimhinfo@nih.gov or call 1-866-615-6464.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this general inbox/phone number for inquiries that do not fit the crisis, press, funding, or website-technical categories.
